qualification.details: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Energy Engineering, or other relevant specializations; Must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh Experience: Relevant experience in tribology, surface modification and advance welding, corrosion analysis, water harvesting, carbon capture, material characterisation or related areas will be preferred Age limit: Maximum 28 years (as on 1 April 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Women Upper age limit relaxable as per Govt./Institute norms | Other conditions: | Qualification and experience may be relaxed by the competent authority in exceptional cases | Desirable: | Relevant experience in tribology, surface modification and advance welding, corrosion analysis, water harvesting, carbon capture, material characterisation or related areas

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format given with the advertisement.
Attach scanned copies of supporting documents.
Email it to [email protected] (Dr. Binayaka Nahak) and [email protected] (Dr. Harinder Singh).
Use the subject line "Application for JRA/SRA/RA (on Contract) – Project ID 7502".
Send on or before 21 days from the date of advertisement till 5 PM.
Give a valid e-mail ID and contact number in the application.
Email it on or before 14 December 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview The Institute reserves the right to accept applications at any time and consider candidates with exceptional credentials The selected candidate may be permitted to register for a Ph.D. at MNNIT Allahabad subject to eligibility and Institute rules Accommodation may be available subject to availability and Institute norms

B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Energy Engineering, or other relevant specializations; candidate must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: MNNIT Allahabad Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 1473/MED/F-80/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MNNIT Allahabad notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Energy Engineering, or other relevant specializations; Must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh Experience: Relevant experience in tribology, surface modification and advance welding, corrosion analysis, water harvesting, carbon capture, material characterisation or related areas will be preferred Age limit: Maximum 28 years (as on 1 April 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Women Upper age limit relaxable as per Govt./Institute norms Other conditions: Qualification and experience may be relaxed by the competent authority in exceptional cases Desirable: Relevant experience in tribology, surface modification and advance welding, corrosion analysis, water harvesting, carbon capture, material characterisation or related areas

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who are not residents of Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial contract of one year, may be extended subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds until completion of the project Duration of the project is 03 years Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project; no right to permanent absorption in the Institute Governed by CSTUP project guidelines and MNNIT Allahabad rules and regulations

content_sections.heading: How Will MNNIT Allahabad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting on the basis of merit, qualifications, experience and the requirements of the project Interview (date and mode informed to shortlisted candidates by e-mail) Shortlisting on merit, qualifications, experience and requirements of the project Shortlisted candidates bring updated CV, publications (if any), original certificates/mark sheets and one set of self-attested photocopies to the interview Employed candidates must produce an NOC from their employer at the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of Date of Birth Mark sheets and certificates of all the examinations passed Category Certificate, if applicable GATE/NET score card, if qualified Experience certificate, if any List of Research Publications (Journals and Conferences), if any

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview The Institute reserves the right to accept applications at any time and consider candidates with exceptional credentials The selected candidate may be permitted to register for a Ph.D. at MNNIT Allahabad subject to eligibility and Institute rules Accommodation may be available subject to availability and Institute norms

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for JRA (on contract).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 14 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years (as on 1 April 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Women Upper age limit relaxable as per Govt./Institute norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fellowship of Rs. 25,000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Energy Engineering, or other relevant specializations; candidate must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualification and experience may be relaxed by the competent authority in exceptional cases.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not residents of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on the basis of merit, qualifications, experience and the requirements of the project. Interview (date and mode informed to shortlisted candidates by e-mail). Shortlisting on merit, qualifications, experience and requirements of the project. Shortlisted candidates bring updated CV, publications (if any), original certificates/mark sheets and one set of self-attested photocopies to the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial contract of one year, may be extended subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds until completion of the project. Duration of the project is 03 years. Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project; no right to permanent absorption in the Institute.
